name: Gemini 3.1 Pro

weak.d: Stronger agentic capability increases potential for unintended actions.

res.d: SWE-bench added for first time in Google's frontier lineup.

lims: Agentic risk — new safety documentation required for expanded capability.
SWE-bench debut — first Google model to report this benchmark.
Benchmarks are chart-images only — no numeric results extractable as text from this card, same as other Gemini 3.x cards.
blurb: Google's latest. First Gemini model to report SWE-bench — notable because Google had not previously used this as a public evaluation. Follows Anthropic's lead in agentic coding benchmarks.

ability.name: Follows the Leader
ability.text: First Gemini to report SWE-bench, adopting the benchmark Anthropic had already made standard.
